question: storage/common-crawl binding is set to none in this unit because no limits[].kind names an absent write path; the integrator may record a conflict (a documented set against a measured record). Should the schema gain a kind for a read-only corpus with no write path, or is none the standing convention for fails-quota read-only corpora?
why: 770 fails-quota records bind none, among them the read-only storage/debian-snapshot, storage/cern-open-data-portal and storage/anna-s-archive; crawler-scraper/commoncrawl keeps request-rate because there the corpus is judged as a read source and the CDXJ index rate binds reads.
